{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history includes positive sentiment (≥0.25) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent true outcomes show mean reversion after a spike.",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1-2 days if model consistently overpredicts after a sharp upward move.",
    "Apply upward bias correction if true outcomes consistently exceed model forecasts during low sentiment periods.",
    "Cap forecast growth above 10% from prior 30-day average if sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Use moving average of last 5 true outcomes to anchor forecast if model shows persistent overestimation.",
    "If sentiment history includes multiple 0.00 entries, assume model is overconfident; apply downward bias correction."
  ]
}
